$doc: Reusable IMPACT sound-effect catalog (the hit/boom you fire on a reveal, a chapter-transition cut, or the payoff of a riser). Mirrors assets/sfx/risers/library.json and assets/music/library.json. WHEN to fire one + pro tips (avoid overuse, build anticipation with a riser/whoosh first, layer for realism) are in WHEN-TO-USE-IMPACTS.md (this folder). Files in this root are trimmed; raw originals + pre-trim versions are in ./_source/. Pair with the risers in ../risers/ (a riser builds INTO an impact).
$schema_note: Pick fields: `weight` 1-5 (how big/heavy the hit is), `attack` (instant transient vs a slight pre-swell into the hit), `tail` (how long it rings — short / medium / long reverb), `low_end` (sub/boom vs mid/punch), `best_for`. duration_sec INCLUDES the reverb tail (most of these are a short transient + a long ring you let play under the new scene). For a tight cut use a short one (ElevenLabs, Soundjay); for a big reveal use a long boom (Impact_Hit_01 trio). LICENSING: these are short transient SFX (not Content-ID matched), no code to paste; confirm the original source's license before commercial use where source is unknown. `mood_class` is the HARD-GATE mood (longform-edited.md section 7): dark = scary/ominous/horror, tense = suspense without dread, epic = big cinematic, hype = bright/energetic, neutral. Pick only a class that fits the chapter's register and music bed; never `dark` in an exciting/hype video. `mood_source` says how it was set: `description` = from the source page text, not yet confirmed by ear (Mike can correct).
